personalInfo.name: Yash Nalawade
personalInfo.summary: Results-driven Computer Engineering student and Full-Stack Developer with hands-on experience building scalable web applications and AI tools. Proficient in React, Node.js, Python, and Machine Learning algorithms. Passionate about engineering software solutions that align with modern Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS).

experience.description:
Engineered responsive UI components using React, reducing page load latency by 40% across 15+ pages.
Collaborated with engineering teams to integrate REST APIs, enhancing dynamic data rendering and session persistence.
Resolved cross-browser compatibility issues, increasing mobile engagement metrics by 25%.

projects.title: CareerPilot AI – AI Career Platform
projects.description:

Implemented real-time ATS scoring algorithms that match job descriptions against candidate metrics.
Integrated LLM APIs for automated bullet-point rewrite suggestions and recruiter simulations.

projects.title: DevRank – Developer Portfolio Engine
projects.description:
Created an open-source analytics dashboard that visualizes developer stats using GitHub's GraphQL API.
Rendered dynamic language distribution charts using Recharts, reducing client-side latencies by 35%.
Maintained clean code standards and documented REST endpoints, securing 100+ GitHub stars.
